in_marathi.name: Shivdas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivdas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shivdas is derived from the name Shiva, which means 'The Auspicious One' or 'The God of Destruction'. The 'das' part of the name means 'gift' or 'servant'. So, Shivdas can be translated to 'Shiva's Gift' or 'Shiva's Servant'.
